title.en: Check your course Moodle AI statement and task conditions.
title.zh: 先核对课程 Moodle 中的 AI 声明与考核要求。

scope.en: Monash University delegates assessment conditions to Chief Examiners via four standard Moodle statements (§1.7.1–1.7.2). Enterprise Copilot and Gemini access is not assessment permission. Proofreading is strictly limited to identifying spelling and grammar errors (§4.6), AI detection software is barred from misconduct evidence, and unacknowledged use is a breach under §4.7.
scope.zh: 莫纳什大学依据《考核制度程序》§1.7.1–1.7.2 由课程主任通过四类标准 Moodle 声明设定 AI 规则。校方企业级 Copilot 与 Gemini 权限不构成考核许可。润色仅严格限于拼写与语法错漏识别（§4.6），AI 检测工具严禁作为不端证据，未声明使用属于违规行为（§4.7）。

do.en: Check the specific Moodle statement (Without Limits, Guided, or Must Not Be Used) before using AI.
do.zh: 在开始每项作业前，务必核对 Moodle 标注的标准 AI 声明（无限制、引导使用或严禁使用）。

do.en: Follow task instructions, acknowledge the AI tool and its contribution, cite when necessary, and acknowledge non-use if AI was permitted but unused.
do.zh: 遵循任务说明，书面注明所用 AI 及贡献程度，必要时引用；任务允许但未使用 AI 时也应声明未使用。

do.en: Use Monash enterprise logins for commercial data protection and protect confidential research and personal data.
do.zh: 使用莫纳什官方账号激活商业数据保护，严禁向外部 AI 工具上传个人隐私、版权课件或机密科研数据。

dont.en: Do not treat campus Microsoft Copilot or Google Gemini access as coursework assessment permission.
dont.zh: 不要把学校提供的 Copilot 或 Gemini 账号权限当作课程作业的使用许可。

dont.en: Do not use generative AI or unapproved browser plugins in scheduled eExams unless authorized on landing page.
dont.zh: 严禁在电子期末考试（eExam）中使用生成式 AI 或未授权插件，除非考试首页明确允许。

dont.en: Do not use AI to rewrite text or change words under the guise of proofreading (§4.6).
dont.zh: 严禁以润色为名利用 AI 重写段落、换词或生成实质内容（润色仅限于识别拼写和语法错漏，§4.6）。

coursework.en: Under Assessment Regime Procedure V12 §1.7–1.7.2 and Table 2, Chief Examiners must determine where and how generative AI can be used in a unit or assessment task, clearly publish use specifications in the required LMS section before the teaching period or at least 4 weeks before task details are released (with Table 2 noting a 4-week deadline before the due date / timetable release), and provide educational reasoning when AI is disallowed. Every Moodle assessment task displays one of four standard AI statements.
coursework.zh: 根据《考核制度程序》V12 §1.7–1.7.2 及表 2，课程主任（Chief Examiner）必须确定课程或考核任务中能否以及如何使用生成式 AI，在教学期开始前或任务细节公布前至少 4 周在 LMS 指定栏目清晰公布使用规范（表 2 规定在截止日期或时间表公布前至少 4 周完成公布），并在禁止使用 AI 时提供教育教学依据。每个 Moodle 考核任务均须展示四类标准 AI 声明之一。

exams.en: In all scheduled electronic examinations (eExams), generative AI is strictly prohibited unless explicit permission is granted by the Chief Examiner and displayed on the eExam landing page. Online spell check, grammar, and translation tools are also barred in closed-book and non-open-access exams.
exams.zh: 在所有排定的电子考试（eExam）中，生成式 AI 一律严格禁止，除非获得课程主任的明确许可并清晰展示在 eExam 登录首页上。在闭卷及非完全开卷考试中，在线拼写检查、语法纠错及翻译工具同样被严格禁用。

disclosure.en: When AI use is allowed or required in an assessment, follow its instructions and restrictions, document the type of AI and its contribution, and provide written acknowledgement of use and extent. Cite and reference using the closest appropriate source type when necessary. If AI is permitted but unused, acknowledge non-use. Further tool, version or prompt documentation follows the actual task instructions; no universal prompt-history requirement is established by the cited assessment-use rule.
disclosure.zh: 当考核任务允许或要求使用 AI 时，学生必须遵循其具体指示与限制，详细记录所用 AI 类型及其贡献，并提供书面使用与程度致谢。必要时参照最接近的来源类型进行引用。若允许使用但实际未用，亦须声明未使用。具体的工具、版本或提示词记录要求依具体任务说明执行；所引用的考核规则未设立全校通用的提示词历史记录强制要求。

privacy_data.en: Monash provides student access to Microsoft Copilot (with commercial data protection via Monash login) and Google Gemini / NotebookLM (opt-in for students 18+). Queries on enterprise accounts are not used to train foundational AI models. However, tool access does not confer coursework assessment permission, and users must avoid uploading personal, sensitive, copyrighted, or confidential data.
privacy_data.zh: 莫纳什大学向学生提供 Microsoft Copilot（通过莫纳什账号单点登录获得商业数据保护）以及面向 18 岁以上学生的自主选择式 Google Gemini / NotebookLM。企业账号上的查询数据不用于训练基础 AI 模型。然而，拥有工具访问权限并不构成课程考核的使用许可，使用者必须避免向外部 AI 工具上传个人、敏感、版权课件或机密数据。

approved_tools.en: Monash provides institutional access to Microsoft Copilot and opt-in Google Gemini/NotebookLM for students aged 18 and over. The tool directory also lists Zoom AI Companion. Other enterprise-service eligibility is not independently established here; institutional access does not grant assessment permission, which follows the Chief Examiner’s task instructions.
approved_tools.zh: 莫纳什大学面向 18 岁及以上学生提供 Microsoft Copilot 及自选 Google Gemini/NotebookLM 的机构访问支持。工具目录中亦列有 Zoom AI Companion。其他企业级服务的适用资格未在此独立确立；获得机构工具访问权限并不代表获得考核使用许可，具体必须遵从课程主任的任务指示。

research_publication.en: HDR students should discuss intended GenAI use and acknowledgement with supervisors. At progress management reviews they are asked about use and must confirm consistency with Monash policies/guidance and acknowledgement. Thesis submission forms and preliminary pages prompt AI disclosure. Thesis examiners must not use GenAI to support, prepare or write their reports.
research_publication.zh: 高等研究学位（HDR）研究生应与导师充分讨论拟使用的生成式 AI 及致谢方式。在进度管理审查时，将被问及 AI 使用情况，并必须确认符合莫纳什大学政策与致谢指引。学位论文提交表格及前置页均提示进行 AI 披露。论文评审专家严禁使用生成式 AI 支持、准备或撰写评审报告。

academic_integrity.en: Under Student Academic Integrity Procedure, minor, trivial or frivolous breaches due to inappropriate academic practice receive the educative response in §6.1: the Chief Examiner/RO/nominee provides support and a written warning outcome, and awards a mark reflecting the practice without imposing a penalty (§6.1.1). For alleged misconduct, where evidence was not provided with the notice of allegation, students must have a reasonable opportunity of not less than five working days to respond to the allegation and evidence before RO determination (§8.3). Invited students may bring a support person who cannot represent or advocate; at Monash Malaysia a staff member or student may represent them (§8.4). Under §11.1, a finding and penalty, or penalty alone, may be appealed; students who admitted the misconduct may appeal only the penalty. The Hearing and Appeals Panels Procedure governs that process. At Malaysia, §11.2 separately permits a written appeal to the Malaysian Registrar General within 14 days of receiving the decision. Where an academic misconduct allegation occurs WITH a research misconduct allegation, §7.6 instead refers the matter to the research-misconduct RO and this coursework procedure does not investigate or determine it.
academic_integrity.zh: 根据《学生学术诚信程序》，因不当学术实践导致的轻微、微不足道或琐碎违规适用 §6.1 的教育性响应：课程主任/责任官员（RO）/被指定人提供指导支持与书面警告结果，评定反映该实践的实际成绩而不施加纪律处分（§6.1.1）。对于涉嫌违规行为，如指控通知未附证据，学生在 RO 作出裁定前必须享有不少于 5 个工作日的合理机会对指控和证据作出回应（§8.3）。受邀学生可携同支持人员（不得担任代理人或辩护人）；在莫纳什马来西亚分校，教职员工或学生可代表其陈述（§8.4）。根据 §11.1，学生可对裁定与处分提出申诉（已承认违规者仅可对处分申诉），由《听证与申诉委员会程序》规范。在马来西亚分校，§11.2 另允许在收到决定后 14 天内向马来西亚注册总署提出书面申诉。当学术不端指控与科研不端指控同时发生时，§7.6 将案件移交科研不端责任官员处理，本课程程序不再进行调查或裁定。

teaching_guidance.en: Chief Examiners set unit assessment conditions; AI detectors are barred from breach evidence; markers must use similarity detection (Turnitin) and academic judgement.
teaching_guidance.zh: 课程主任负责制定课程单元考核条件；AI 检测工具严禁作为判定学术不端的证据；评卷人必须依靠相似度检测（Turnitin）及专业学术判断。

do.en: Check the specific Moodle statement (Without Limits, Guided, or Must Not Be Used) before using AI.
do.zh: 在开始每项作业前，务必核对 Moodle 标注的标准 AI 声明（无限制、引导使用或严禁使用）。

do.en: Follow task instructions, acknowledge the AI tool and its contribution, cite when necessary, and acknowledge non-use if AI was permitted but unused.
do.zh: 遵循任务说明，书面注明所用 AI 及贡献程度，必要时引用；任务允许但未使用 AI 时也应声明未使用。

do.en: To protect your data, it is recommended you use your Monash login credentials when accessing enterprise tools such as Microsoft Copilot (with the green shield) or Google Gemini/NotebookLM (opt-in for students aged 18+), and as a general rule always avoid giving personal information to AI systems.
do.zh: 为保护个人数据，建议使用莫纳什大学官方账号登录企业工具，例如微软 Copilot（具有绿色盾牌标识）或 Google Gemini/NotebookLM（年满18周岁学生可选择加入），并遵循通用原则始终避免向 AI 系统输入个人信息。

dont.en: Do not treat campus Microsoft Copilot or Google Gemini access as coursework assessment permission.
dont.zh: 不要把学校提供的 Copilot 或 Gemini 账号权限当作课程作业的使用许可。

dont.en: Do not use generative AI or unapproved browser plugins in scheduled eExams unless authorized on landing page.
dont.zh: 严禁在电子期末考试（eExam）中使用生成式 AI 或未授权插件，除非考试首页明确允许。

dont.en: Unless otherwise stated in the LMS, default proofreading allows identifying errors and suggesting corrections to spelling and grammar; do not use AI to rewrite passages, change words, or reformat text, and do not breach specific assessment conditions set by chief examiners (§4.6, §4.7).
dont.zh: 除非教学管理系统（LMS）另有规定，默认的文本校对限于识别错误并提出拼写和语法修改建议；切勿使用 AI 重写段落、替换词语或重新排版文本，且不得违反首席考官设定的具体考核条件（§4.6、§4.7）。

scope.en: Audience and activity scope varies strictly by source: Assessment Regime Procedure V12 §1.7–1.7.2 governs Chief Examiner coursework conditions and 4 standard Moodle banners; eExam rules strictly prohibit GenAI in scheduled supervised electronic exams unless explicit on landing page; Library guidance governs written acknowledgement and citation; Student Academic Integrity Procedure V4.1 governs proofreading boundaries (§4.6) and detector evidence prohibitions; Enterprise Copilot and Gemini access terms govern institutional SSO logins without granting coursework permission.
scope.zh: 受众与活动适用范围严格依具体来源区分：《考核制度程序》V12 §1.7–1.7.2 规范课程统筹主任制定的课程考核条件与 4 类标准 Moodle 声明；eExam 规则在排定监考的电子考试中严格禁止 GenAI（除非考试首页明确特许）；图书馆指引规范书面致谢与规范引用；《学生学术诚信程序》V4.1 严格界定润色边界（§4.6）与检测软件证据禁令；企业级 Copilot 与 Gemini 访问条款规范机构单点登录，不构成课程考核使用许可。

topicBasis.coursework: Under Assessment Regime Procedure V12 §1.7–1.7.2 and Table 2, Chief Examiners must determine where and how generative AI can be used in a unit or assessment task, clearly publish use specifications in the required LMS section before the teaching period or at least 4 weeks before task details are released (with Table 2 noting a 4-week deadline before the due date / timetable release), and provide educational reasoning when AI is disallowed. Every Moodle assessment task displays one of four standard AI statements.
topicBasis.exams: In all scheduled electronic examinations (eExams), generative AI is strictly prohibited unless explicit permission is granted by the Chief Examiner and displayed on the eExam landing page. Online spell check, grammar, and translation tools are also barred in closed-book and non-open-access exams.
topicBasis.disclosure: When AI use is allowed or required in an assessment, follow its instructions and restrictions, document the type of AI and its contribution, and provide written acknowledgement of use and extent. Cite and reference using the closest appropriate source type when necessary. If AI is permitted but unused, acknowledge non-use. Further tool, version or prompt documentation follows the actual task instructions; no universal prompt-history requirement is established by the cited assessment-use rule.

However, tool access does not confer coursework assessment permission, and users must avoid uploading personal, sensitive, copyrighted, or confidential data.

academic_integrity.en: Under Student Academic Integrity Procedure, minor, trivial or frivolous breaches due to inappropriate academic practice receive the educative response in §6.1: the Chief Examiner/RO/nominee provides support and a written warning outcome, and awards a mark reflecting the practice without imposing a penalty (§6.1.1). For alleged misconduct, where evidence was not provided with the notice of allegation, students must have a reasonable opportunity of not less than five working days to respond to the allegation and evidence before RO determination (§8.3). Invited students may bring a support person who cannot represent or advocate; at Monash Malaysia a staff member or student may represent them (§8.4). Under §11.1, a finding and penalty, or penalty alone, may be appealed; students who admitted the misconduct may appeal only the penalty. The Hearing and Appeals Panels Procedure governs that process. At Malaysia, §11.2 separately permits a written appeal to the Malaysian Registrar General within 14 days of receiving the decision. Where an academic misconduct allegation occurs WITH a research misconduct allegation, §7.6 instead refers the matter to the research-misconduct RO and this coursework procedure does not investigate or determine it.
academic_integrity.zh: 根据《学生学术诚信程序》，因不当学术实践导致的轻微、微不足道或琐碎违规适用 §6.1 的教育性响应：课程主任/责任官员（RO）/被指定人提供指导支持与书面警告结果，评定反映该实践的实际成绩而不施加纪律处分（§6.1.1）。对于涉嫌违规行为，如指控通知未附证据，学生在 RO 作出裁定前必须享有不少于 5 个工作日的合理机会对指控和证据作出回应（§8.3）。受邀学生可携同支持人员（不得担任代理人或辩护人）；在莫纳什马来西亚分校，教职员工或学生可代表其陈述（§8.4）。根据 §11.1，学生可对裁定与处分提出申诉（已承认违规者仅可对处分申诉），由《听证与申诉委员会程序》规范。在马来西亚分校，§11.2 另允许在收到决定后 14 天内向马来西亚注册总署提出书面申诉。当学术不端指控与科研不端指控同时发生时，§7.6 将案件移交科研不端责任官员处理，本课程程序不再进行调查或裁定。

teaching_guidance.en: Chief Examiners set unit assessment conditions; AI detectors are barred from breach evidence; markers must use similarity detection (Turnitin) and academic judgement.
teaching_guidance.zh: 课程主任负责制定课程单元考核条件；AI 检测工具严禁作为判定学术不端的证据；评卷人必须依靠相似度检测（Turnitin）及专业学术判断。
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 课程大纲设计与考核评分标准。

security_procurement.en: Under AI Operations Procedure §1.3, decisions affecting rights/interests require human staff review and accountability; non-procured systems prohibited.
security_procurement.zh: 根据《AI 运行程序》§1.3，对涉及个人权利与利益的决策必须由人工教职人员进行审查并承担责任；严禁使用未经采购审批的系统。
security_procurement.meaningEn: Administrative and assessment decisions affecting individuals
security_procurement.meaningZh: 涉及个人的行政管理与考核评估决策规范。
